name: Der Mann mit der Maschine square pictogram
source_description: Square black and white pictogram supplied by the project owner for the Android launcher icon.
attribution: Der Mann mit der Maschine / Mathias Kettner
transformation: None: the supplied PNG is copied byte for byte. Android XML scales it proportionally to a nominal 45 by 45 dp square on a 108 dp adaptive layer, over a black background. Symmetric insets leave room for Android pixel rounding.
rights_notice: Brand artwork retains its author's rights. The graphics permission in GRAPHICS-LICENSE.txt concerns the blue-7 archive's module faceplates and circuit icons.
